description.value: Diya Restaurant & Sweets is a fully vegetarian Indian restaurant serving an extensive menu of North Indian mains, South Indian dosas, street-food chaats, Indo-Chinese dishes, and house-made sweets. The kitchen uses freshly ground herbs and no MSG, with every dish customizable from mild to extra spicy. It offers a warm sit-down dining room alongside pickup and direct-contact delivery.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces, covered) at 68m; rack (5 spaces) at 98m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bharatdiya.com is clearly for Diya Restaurant & Sweets and confirms an active, operating Indian restaurant. The website's contact page gives the address as 13655 72 Ave, Surrey, BC V3W 2P2, which conflicts with the OSM community tag of 'Tsawwassen' — however, the OSM coordinates (49.1338°N, 122.844°W) are geographically consistent with Surrey, not Tsawwassen, so the community tag appears to be the error. The menu is entirely vegetarian (OSM diet:vegetarian=yes confirmed by a menu containing no meat items), and the website explicitly offers pickup/takeout; no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi was found. A suspicious spam-injected phrase ('Sexy Vintage Teen Fitness Tube oral anabolic steroids not only sport: fitness') appears in the scraped homepage content, suggesting the website may have been partially compromised or has embedded ad content.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Tsawwassen' but the website address (13655 72 Ave, Surrey, BC V3W 2P2) and the OSM coordinates (49.1338°N, 122.844°W) both point to Surrey — the community tag appears incorrect and may need correction in OSM.
OSM record has no address or phone; address and phone are taken from website only and cannot be cross-confirmed against OSM.

Scraped homepage contains an apparent spam-injected phrase: 'Sexy Vintage Teen Fitness Tube oral anabolic steroids not only sport: fitness' — the website may have been partially compromised or contains embedded third-party ad content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible Indian restaurant confirmed open by OSM check_date 2025-05-23 and a live website. Fully vegetarian menu and takeout availability make it useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Secondary phone number from website: 778-893-3505. Delivery is available by contacting the restaurant directly (minimum order $50, charges vary by distance).

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu contains exclusively vegetarian items (paneer, veggie, dal, lentil dishes) with no meat listed anywhere on the menu
